description: Frozen schema drift: what `prisma migrate diff` (database built from the migrations -> schema.prisma) proposes. None of it is applied, because most statements are DROPs of legacy objects that hold data in at least one real database. The build fails on ANY statement not listed here, and when a listed one disappears. See docs/SCHEMA_DRIFT.md.

statements.note: Legacy retrieval table the schema no longer models. Kept: production has 0 rows, staging holds 630 pgvector chunks in knowledge_base_chunks. Dropping it would destroy data.

The schema and the databases disagree on a foreign key (present in staging and a fresh build, absent in production; delete behaviour differs: call_logs.contact_id is RESTRICT in the database but SET NULL in the schema). Changing it alters delete semantics: owner decision.
